extracted.intended_audience: short-story authors, magazine editors, and anthology compilers (writers seeking publication / readers of the Yearbook)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and notations used in the Yearbook's Roll of Honor and the companion list of magazine addresses for short stories published in the specified coverage period. Includes criteria for which stories/authors are listed, how 'best' stories are marked, and notation for repeat inclusions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coverage period
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Yearbook's contents (addresses, Roll of Honor entries, and selections) are confined to works/magazines within this stated timeframe; selection and inclusion pertain to that period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Addresses list scope / completeness
rubrics_metrics.description: Note. This address list does not aim to be complete, but is based simply on the magazines which I have considered for this volume.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The compiled magazine-address list is explicitly non-exhaustive — it reflects only the magazines the editor considered for the volume rather than all possible short-story outlets. Users should not treat the list as comprehensive.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nationality requirement for Roll of Honor
rubrics_metrics.description: Only stories by American authors are listed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Biographical Roll of Honor includes exclusively stories authored by Americans; foreign authors' stories are omitted from this particular listing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best sixty marking
rubrics_metrics.description: The best sixty stories are indicated by an asterisk before the title of the story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An asterisk marks the editor's selection of the top sixty stories in the covered period. This is the explicit indicator of 'best' stories within the Roll of Honor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notation for prior inclusions
rubrics_metrics.description: The index figures 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 prefixed to the name of the author indicate that his work has been included in the Rolls of Honor for 1914, 1915, 1916, 1917, and 1918 respectively.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric prefixes beside an author's name denote repeat recognition in previous years' Rolls of Honor; these figures show historical inclusion rather than rank or score for the current year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exclusion of reprints
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only original publications (not reprinted works) are considered for inclusion in the Roll of Honor; reprints are deliberately omitted from the listing.
